_comment: Copy for /equipment. Machine DATA (names, specs, years, counts) lives in company.json; this file holds only the English text. Descriptions are keyed by machine id — max two sentences, one for highlighted machines. Register: what the machine does and within what limits. No marketing adjectives, present tense, no first person.

meta.title: Equipment — tube laser, robotic welding, CNC panel processing | GS Trubna Mebel
meta.description: The machine park: BLM Group tube fibre laser, Crippa five-axis bending, Fanuc welding robots, HOMAG CNC centres — two complete chains in one factory.

intro.heading: Equipment
intro.body: Two complete production chains operate in one facility: metal fabrication and wood panel processing. Below are all {count} machine groups in process order — what each machine does and within what limits.
intro._bodyNote: {count} is replaced at build time with the number of machine groups in company.json, so the figure never diverges from the list.

descriptions.blm-lt5: Cuts round tube from Ø10 to Ø120 mm and profiles from 15×15 to 120×120 mm, up to 5 mm wall, in carbon steel, stainless steel, aluminium, brass and alloy steels.
descriptions.adige-cutting: Cuts tube to ±0.05 mm at 2,500–3,000 pieces per shift, with automated tube feeding and a self-cleaning system.
descriptions.band-cutting: Semi-automatic and manual band saws with programmable automatic infeed and angled cuts.
descriptions.disc-cutting: Cutting with chrome-vanadium and abrasive discs, plus angle grinding.
descriptions.crippa-ca532: Bends tube up to Ø32 mm and profiles up to 35×35 mm on five CNC-programmed axes with automated infeed.
descriptions.alfa-bending: Hydraulic and semi-automated benders for horizontal, vertical and variable-radius bending of tube and profile.
descriptions.three-roll-bending: Contour bending, roundness correction and radius adjustment for coils, arcs and round profiles.
descriptions.hydraulic-punching: Die cutting, hole punching and embossing with a quick-change tooling system. Built to GS Trubna Mebel specification.
descriptions.presses-63t: 63 t presses for forming, bending, punching and cutting.
descriptions.fanuc-welding: Two welding robots, each serving two stations so welding runs as a continuous process.
descriptions.kuka-sanding: Sands welded frames with automated infeed and sensor-based quality monitoring.
descriptions.shot-blasting: Three-turbine blasting with an overhead hook system for full surface access; prepares surfaces for coating adhesion.
descriptions.powder-coating-line: Conveyor line at 0.75–2.0 m/min: pretreatment, drying, a six-gun automated powder chamber and gas curing — with a second powder chamber and oven in line, so a second coat is applied without removing the part from the conveyor.
descriptions.homag-nesting: Boring, milling and cutting of plywood, timber panels, MDF and chipboard across two working stations.
descriptions.homag-venture: Drilling, sawing and cutting of MDF, chipboard, plywood and timber across two working stations.
descriptions.mayer-panel-saw: Panel sizing with integrated cutting-plan software and multi-panel processing.
descriptions.fravol-edgebander: Edgebanding at up to 20 m/min with pre-milling, glue pot, edge trimming and a polishing station.
descriptions.paoloni-spindle-moulder: Spindle moulder for profiling solid timber and panel components.
descriptions.paoloni-thicknesser: Three-phase thicknesser for dimensioning timber to thickness.
descriptions.paoloni-surface-planer: Surface planer for flattening and squaring timber faces.
descriptions.centorrino-belt-sander: Surface sanding and levelling in preparation for painting.
descriptions.slipcon-brush-sander: Two brush rollers and two oscillating brush discs for surface finishing.
descriptions.superfici-spray-line: Spray line with two sets of oscillating guns, low- and high-pressure regulation, a cleaning unit and a line supervision system.

robotics.heading: Robotics
robotics.body: Two Fanuc welding robots and one Kuka sanding robot run in the metal chain. Robotic welding and sanding hold the same geometry and surface finish from the first frame in a batch to the last — output does not depend on who is on shift.

closingCta.heading: Send a drawing. Get an assessment.
closingCta.body: Enquiries are read by engineers who work with these machines daily. You get an answer on manufacturability, tolerances and realistic batch sizes — not a brochure.
